steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option( 'blogname', 'OpenStation WooCommerce Workbench' );

$admin = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
if ( $admin ) {
    update_user_meta( $admin->ID, 'desktop_mode_mode', '1' );
    update_user_meta( $admin->ID, 'desktop_mode_seen_intros', array( 'activation-welcome' ) );
    if ( function_exists( 'desktop_mode_set_default_window' ) ) {
        desktop_mode_set_default_window(
            $admin->ID,
            'native:desktop-mode-fulfillment-workbench-for-woocommerce'
        );
    }
}

if ( class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) && function_exists( 'wc_create_order' ) ) {
    $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $product->set_name( 'OpenStation Trail Pack' );
    $product->set_sku( 'OS-DEMO-001' );
    $product->set_regular_price( '49.00' );
    $product->set_manage_stock( true );
    $product->set_stock_quantity( 24 );
    $product->set_status( 'publish' );
    $product_id = $product->save();

    $fixtures = array(
        array( 'processing', 'Alex Merchant', 2 ),
        array( 'processing', 'Riley Shopkeeper', 1 ),
        array( 'on-hold', 'Morgan Operator', 3 ),
    );

    foreach ( $fixtures as $fixture ) {
        $order = wc_create_order();
        $order->add_product( wc_get_product( $product_id ), $fixture[2] );
        $order->set_address(
            array(
                'first_name' => strtok( $fixture[1], ' ' ),
                'last_name'  => substr( strrchr( $fixture[1], ' ' ), 1 ),
                'email'      => 'merchant@example.test',
                'address_1'  => '100 Playground Way',
                'city'       => 'Demo City',
                'state'      => 'IL',
                'postcode'   => '60601',
                'country'    => 'US',
            ),
            'billing'
        );
        $order->set_address(
            array(
                'first_name' => strtok( $fixture[1], ' ' ),
                'last_name'  => substr( strrchr( $fixture[1], ' ' ), 1 ),
                'address_1'  => '100 Playground Way',
                'city'       => 'Demo City',
                'state'      => 'IL',
                'postcode'   => '60601',
                'country'    => 'US',
            ),
            'shipping'
        );
        $order->calculate_totals();
        $order->set_status( $fixture[0] );
        $order->set_created_via( 'openstation-playground' );
        $order->save();
    }
}
